# Ifeoluwa Taiwo

> Ifeoluwa Taiwo is a product marketer, go-to-market strategist and brand marketer. They market products and tell brand stories to drive growth, across B2C and B2B. This is their portfolio site.

Currently Global Product Marketing Manager at Onboard (2025 to date), a stablecoin neobank for global professionals. Earlier roles: Marketing Generalist at FBI Africa (2024 to 2025), Advocate at The Graph (2023 to 2024) and Community Moderator at Blockchain.com (2022 to 2023).

Strengths: product launches, rebrands, campaigns, GTM strategy, content, partnerships, community and talent programmes. Tools: Canva, Meta Ads, GA4, Notion, Customer.io, SendGrid, Firebase, Attio, Google Workspace and Claude Code.

Contact: hi@ifeoluwa.xyz. Also on LinkedIn (https://www.linkedin.com/in/ifeoluwa-marketing/) and X (https://x.com/_WillOG).

## Case studies

- [EUR/GBP Global Accounts](https://ifeoluwa.xyz/project-eur-gbp-global-accounts): Owned end-to-end product marketing for the launch of EUR and GBP accounts at Onboard. 300+ new accounts and six-figure dollar deposits in the first month.
- [Onboard Business Pivot](https://ifeoluwa.xyz/project-onboard-business-pivot): Led product, content and brand marketing for Onboard's launch into B2B global payments. Eight-figure dollar transaction volume in three months and 4 global products launched.
- [Consumer Product Refresh](https://ifeoluwa.xyz/project-consumer-product-refresh): Creative direction and content for Onboard's repositioning and redesign, from web pages to the app and Play Store. Website views up 412% and engagement up 82% in the first week.
- [Onboard Test Pilots](https://ifeoluwa.xyz/project-onboard-test-pilots): A community of product testers who validate new features before public release. 4 major features tested and 2 Test Pilots secured paid roles.
- [Onchain Design Sprint](https://ifeoluwa.xyz/project-onchain-design-sprint): A 2-week design sprint with Dacoit Design and other brands. 100+ designers trained and 7+ secured paid roles in Web3.
- [Stablecoin Sprint](https://ifeoluwa.xyz/project-stablecoin-sprint): Co-organised, with creative direction, with Base West Africa, cNGN and Uglycash to grow stablecoin education and adoption in Africa. 70+ active users onboarded across 3 products.
